spec.what: Advanced Temporary Fencing's demob-week papers, photographed by Andrew on 30 Oct 2026 ("I have more fence dockets"): nineteen blue-book collection forms 28584-28602 (removals 26-29 Oct 2026), seven green-book service notes 24496-24500, 24001 and 24002 (26-28 Oct: scrim removals and fence relocations), and eight red-book hire agreements 36775, 36777-36783 (the construction-zone fences going in 26-29 Oct). Every paper read twice at full size and by an independent reader working from the photographs alone, who agreed on every count, metre and date. Recorded through the page's own forms: collections as counts only (no charge, credit or metres inferred); service notes as the crew's hours and the metres the note states; hire agreements charged at the 2026 card and costed at Advanced's sheet by the page's own rules. 36780 and 36782 carry no metres and go on as components only (nothing charged from them): 36780 reads as a rewrite of 36778 (same site, same day, same 51/47/45), 36782's metres wait on Advanced's sheet or Andrew's word.
